name: OneCast
product: OneCast for Mac by Bitwise Solutions

evidence.says: The vendor offers OneCast 3.5 for macOS and explicitly states it supports Apple Silicon natively.
The vendor announced the macOS release of OneCast 3.5 on November 2, 2026.

notes: The vendor distributes the Mac version directly.

name: SnapGene
product: SnapGene by GSL Biotech (now Dotmatics)

evidence.says: The vendor says it continues to distribute the current subscriber Mac app as a universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel.
The vendor lists 9.0.1 as the current version, offers its Mac download, and dates it November 24, 2026.

notes: The vendor supplies older perpetual-license releases on a separate track.

name: Apache NetBeans 14
product: Apache NetBeans 14 by the Apache Software Foundation

evidence.says: Apache dates NetBeans 14 to June 9, 2022 and links its archived macOS installer.
Apache states that older NetBeans releases are no longer supported.
Friends of Apache NetBeans publishes an arm64 installer for Apache NetBeans 31.

limitation: The architecture of the final Apache NetBeans 14 Mac bundle was not verified.
notes: This listing identifies the version-specific NetBeans 14 bundle. The NetBeans product line continues, and NetBeans 31 has a separate community Apple Silicon package.

name: Chiudi tutto
product: Chiudi tutto Automator workflow applet

evidence.says: The uploaded bundle metadata identifies version 1.3 as an Automator applet with an Application Stub executable.
Orbolandia offers a workflow with this name to quit apps and describes creating it in Automator.

notes: The listing tracks an exported Automator workflow.

name: Fiji
product: Fiji distribution of ImageJ, maintained by the Fiji project

evidence.says: Fiji's dated official archive includes a macOS arm64 build with a bundled JDK for build 20261123-0817.
The project identifies Fiji as its ImageJ distribution and distinguishes its Latest and Stable download channels.

notes: The version is the Fiji distribution build identifier.

name: Alice 3 Installer
product: Alice 3 Mac installer, Carnegie Mellon University’s Alice Project

evidence.says: The Alice Project names and dates the archived Mac download as the Alice 3.6.0.2 installer.

notes: The scanned Install4j bundle is the installer for Alice 3. The Alice editor is a separate listing candidate.

name: amac
product: Unidentified amac build using a React Native example bundle identifier

evidence.says: A React Native template reproduction shows the org.reactjs.native.example prefix on a generated app bundle identifier.

limitation: No public vendor, release, or independently identifiable Mac product was found for the exact bundle ID.
notes: The prefix is a template clue. It does not establish whether this particular build was a demo, prototype, or privately distributed app.

name: ApacheDirectoryStudio
product: Apache Directory Studio, Apache Software Foundation standalone LDAP client

evidence.says: Apache offers one macOS release package, M17, explicitly labeled x86_64.
An Apple Silicon user confirms successful operation under Rosetta with x86 OpenJDK, and an Apache contributor confirms the source-level ARM build was pending release packaging.
Homebrew identifies M17 as Intel macOS software that requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

notes: Native support was merged in source after M17. When using the official Intel package, the JVM must also be x86_64.

name: Kdenlive
product: Kdenlive, KDE video editor

evidence.says: KDE lists 26.08.3 as the stable release and offers a separate macOS Silicon build alongside the Intel build.
KDE dates the 26.08.3 release to November 7, 2026.

notes: The current macOS downloads require macOS 13 or later.

name: XeroxUniversal Registration
product: XeroxUniversal Registration helper by Leader Technologies for Xerox

evidence.says: The uploaded Info.plist identifies the XeroxUniversal executable as XeroxUniversal Registration 1.02 by Leader Technologies and XeroxUniversal, with the PowerReg bundle ID.

limitation: The parent Xerox installer or printer model for this particular copy was not verified.
notes: The bundle is a product-registration utility.

name: RuneScape
product: Jagex RuneScape standalone Mac client

evidence.says: Homebrew identifies the directly downloadable RuneScape.app as version 1.0 and flags that it needs Rosetta.
Jagex identifies the Intel game clients and documents that Rosetta lets those builds run on Apple Silicon.
Static inspection of this official DMG found com.jagex.RuneScape version 1.0 and an x86_64-only RuneScape.app/Contents/MacOS/RuneScape executable.
Jagex lists the RuneScape game client separately from its Apple Silicon Jagex Launcher download.

limitation: This result covers the exact standalone bundle distributed at the direct download URL. The architecture of any different build delivered through Jagex Launcher was not established.
notes: The Jagex Launcher has its own native build and should have its own listing.

name: F5 VPN
product: F5 VPN for macOS, the browser-launched VPN client in F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM)

evidence.says: F5 says its macOS Edge Client and Web clients run natively on Intel and Apple Silicon starting with APM Client 7.2.6.
F5 identifies its current macOS Web VPN build as 7274.2026.1023.1 in the APM Client 7.2.7.4 release and names its Mac UI F5 VPN.

limitation: F5 dates the release-note update, but it does not give a separate release date for the macOS Web VPN build.
notes: This corresponds to the macOS Web VPN app in the APM client package. F5 Access is a separate client.

name: SimpleFloatingClock
product: Simple Floating Clock by Splook

evidence.says: The vendor ZIP contains SimpleFloatingClock.app 1.8, whose Contents/MacOS/SimpleFloatingClock executable I inspected and found to contain only x86_64 and i386 slices.

limitation: The vendor product page was unavailable, and I found no report confirming Rosetta on an Apple Silicon Mac.
notes: The vendor archive is still reachable. A report that it works on macOS 13.4 did not identify the hardware.

name: ioCentre
product: Genius ioCentre tablet driver configuration utility by KYE Systems

evidence.says: The uploaded app metadata gives ioCentre as the executable and bundle name with bundle version 1.3.
The Genius Mac tablet manual identifies ioCentre as the installed driver configuration tool and gives the Genius Tablet preference pane as an alternate way to open the settings.

limitation: The specific tablet model that supplied the scanned bundle was not identified.
notes: This is a configuration utility shipped with Genius tablet drivers.

name: DERT
product: Desktop Exploration of Remote Terrain (DERT) by NASA Ames Research Center

evidence.says: NASA publishes the DERT 1.0.6 Mac ZIP, in which I verified the bundle ID and found that dert_1.0.6_osx/dert.app/Contents/MacOS/JavaAppLauncher is x86_64 only.

limitation: I found no Apple Silicon or Rosetta runtime verification for the official Mac bundle.
notes: NASA's latest GitHub release is still 1.0.6 and remains downloadable.

name: Yandex.Disk
product: Yandex Disk desktop sync client by Yandex

evidence.says: The versioned cask data identifies Yandex.Disk 3.2.53 build 3373 and marks Rosetta as required for the vendor DMG.
Yandex documents that the existing macOS client upgrades to Yandex Disk 3.0.

limitation: I could not inspect the current vendor DMG or verify an exact release date.
notes: The current macOS app ships as Yandex.Disk.2.app. Disk 4.0 is listed under Windows in Yandex's desktop support.

name: MieSimulatorGUI_v1_3
product: Mie Simulator GUI by the Virtual Photonics Technology Initiative, University of California, Irvine

evidence.says: The project publishes both the original Mie Simulator GUI 1.3 Mac bundle and the current 2.1 ZIP, whose Contents/MacOS/MieSimulatorGUI_v2_1 executable I inspected and found to be x86_64 only.
The maintainer's release metadata identifies 2.1 as the latest release and dates it to July 23, 2026.

limitation: I found no Apple Silicon or Rosetta runtime report for 2.1.
notes: The project incorporates the version in the bundle ID. The old 1.3 bundle and current 2.1 bundle came from the same project.

name: KnightTouchBar2000
product: KnightTouchBar2000, Anthony Da Mota’s Touch Bar animation app

evidence.says: The author archived the repository in December 2021 and says the release download was removed and users must compile the code.
The historical bundle in the author’s repository has the exact bundle ID and identifies itself as version 1.0.

limitation: The final packaged build and its architecture were not established.
notes: The source changelog reaches v1.1.2, with Swift 5 support. The bundled v1.0 snapshot does not establish the architecture of the final release.

name: YiHomeMac International
product: YI Home for international YI cameras, Shanghai Xiaoyi Technology, listed by Kami Vision

evidence.says: The vendor’s Mac App Store listing describes the international camera client and dates the latest release, 1.2.0, to March 19, 2024.
MacUpdater identifies the exact bundle ID and lists v1.2.0 (3.1.0) as Intel.
Opt-in app inventory records for the exact ID identify v1.2.0 as Intel-only.

limitation: The architecture sources inventory installed apps. A firsthand report or vendor statement confirming the current client runs under Rosetta was not found.
notes: The separately listed YI Home mobile app has different distribution and Mac requirements.

name: Launchpad
product: Apple Launchpad, the macOS system app launcher

evidence.says: Apple’s Sequoia guide documents Launchpad as a built-in macOS way to browse and open apps.
Apple’s Tahoe guide documents Spotlight’s Applications results for finding and browsing apps.

notes: The scan is for the macOS Launchpad launcher component. Tahoe exposes the app-browsing interface through Spotlight.

name: Authorizer
product: Loom Authorizer, AIR Music Technology’s licensing utility

evidence.says: AIR identifies Loom Classic and Loom II as plug-ins with legacy iLok authorization and describes the newer inMusic unlock workflow.

limitation: AIR’s current guide does not document the old helper binary itself.
notes: The scan names Loom Authorizer and the AIR Authorizer bundle. Any compatibility entry for the Loom instrument must be based on the instrument itself.

name: PlayOnMac
product: PlayOnMac, the PlayOnMac project’s Wine-based Windows application manager

evidence.says: The project offers 4.4.4 as its current Mac disk image.
MacUpdate labels the PlayOnMac 4.4.4 distribution Intel 64.
An Apple M1 user reports running PlayOnMac 4.4.4 and posts a log identifying Rosetta translation in its Wine workflow.
A user reports launching 4.4.4 on both M1 and M3 Macs, with a regression in installing a specific Windows application.
Two users report that the disk image labeled 4.4.4 contains an app labeled 4.4.2.

limitation: The 574 MB disk image was not inspected. The app’s internal version and the range of working guest applications remain unverified.
notes: Version 4.4.4 refers to the vendor-labeled distribution. Rosetta evidence includes the bundled Wine runtime.

name: Max
product: Max audio converter and CD ripper by Stephen Booth

evidence.says: Stephen Booth lists 0.9.2 beta 4 as the newest posted release, and I inspected Max.app/Contents/MacOS/Max from that official DMG and found it x86_64 only.
Booth's release metadata gives the exact publication date and links Max-0.9.2b4.dmg.

limitation: I found no credible Apple Silicon or Rosetta runtime report for the published binary.
notes: The similarly named Cycling '74 Max cask belongs to an unrelated product.

name: Toolkit
product: Seagate Toolkit for Mac

evidence.says: Seagate explicitly states that the Toolkit app and its installers have shipped as universal Mac binaries starting at 2.44.
Seagate documents Toolkit 2.47.x as the release series supported on macOS 27.
Opt-in Mac app inventory reports universal builds of the exact com.seagate.toolkit bundle, including 2.47.0.14 and the newer 2.49.0.5.

limitation: The exact 2.49.0.5 build is identified by community inventory. Seagate states the universal policy from 2.44 onward but its public macOS 27 compatibility table does not specify an exact latest build or date.
notes: Seagate’s current web ZIP contains the separately versioned Toolkit Installer 2.44.0.7, bundle ID com.seagate.toolkit.installer.

name: Graphic
product: Graphic for Mac (formerly iDraw and Autodesk Graphic), published by Picta, Inc.

evidence.says: The Mac App Store still lists Picta's Graphic and gives 3.1, dated January 20, 2018, as its latest Mac version.
Community telemetry reports the exact com.indeeo.idraw version 3.1 as Intel-only.
The developer of a migration utility for Graphic documents that the Mac app runs under Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

limitation: Apple Silicon operation is documented by a third party and was not independently tested here.

name: HardwareManager
product: Unidentified Qt application named HardwareManager

evidence.says: The submitted bundle metadata declares a Qt/QMake-generated identifier using the generic com.yourcompany prefix and gives build 1.14.0 with no identifiable publisher.

limitation: Exact name, bundle ID, icon name and build searches yielded no independently identifiable public Mac app.
notes: Revisit if a publisher or containing software package can be identified.

name: Movavi Video Editor Plus 2022
product: Movavi Video Editor Plus 2022 by Movavi Software

evidence.says: Movavi's Mac changelog identifies 22.4.1 on August 23, 2022 as the last 22.x update before the next annual release.
Movavi documents that old lifetime-license versions remain available to owners as fixed versions without ongoing updates.
Movavi advertises native ARM support for its current Mac edition.

limitation: The binary architecture of the final 2022 edition remains unverified. The v22.3 note about M1 feature support does not identify binary architecture.
notes: This entry is the version-specific 2022 bundle. The maintained edition is Movavi Video Editor 2027, whose Mac changelog lists v27.4.0 as current.

name: BitPerfect
product: BitPerfect, the iTunes and Apple Music audio player by BitPerfect Sound Inc.

evidence.says: The developer announced version 3.2.0 on October 10, 2019 and directed customers to the Mac App Store.
Apple’s live U.S. storefront lookup returns zero results for the developer-linked app ID.
Apple’s live Canadian storefront lookup also returns zero results for the developer-linked app ID.
The archived release metadata for the exact bundle ID identifies v3.2.0 build 914 as Intel.

limitation: No formal end-of-life notice or alternative official distribution was found.
notes: The last documented version is Intel-only. The formerly linked Mac App Store release was unavailable in the storefronts checked.

name: ipcalculatorver4
product: IP Calculator v4, the Mac subnet calculator by EmbeddedSoft Canada / Ranko Rodic

evidence.says: Historical Mac app metadata identifies ipcalculatorver4 as Ranko Rodic’s IPv4 subnet calculator and lists version 2.1.
Apple’s live Canadian storefront lookup returns zero results for the historical Mac App Store ID.
Apple’s live U.S. storefront lookup also returns zero results for the historical Mac App Store ID.

limitation: No formal end-of-life notice, alternative vendor distribution, or reliable architecture evidence for the last known version was found.
notes: The original Mac App Store listing is unavailable in the storefronts checked. Similarly named iOS subnet calculators were excluded.

name: Google Earth Pro
product: Google Earth Pro for desktop, Google LLC

evidence.says: Google lists 7.3.7 as the newest direct Mac installer and announces a June 25, 2027 end to new desktop downloads.
Static inspection of the official DMG’s app payload confirmed bundle com.Google.GoogleEarthPro, build 7.3.7.1327, and an x86_64-only Mach-O at Google Earth Pro.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Earth.
Desktop users report that Google Earth Pro runs through Rosetta on Apple Silicon.

limitation: The downloaded build was inspected statically. Rosetta evidence is community-reported and does not identify its exact point build.
notes: The desktop app is still available on the audit date. Google has announced that new downloads will end June 25, 2027.

name: Ankama Launcher
product: Ankama Launcher (Zaap) by Ankama

evidence.says: Ankama's official Mac update manifest lists only x64 ZIP and DMG assets for 3.15.20, dated November 25, 2026.
The Homebrew cask identifies the com.ankama.zaap launcher and flags Rosetta for its older 3.15.2 entry.
A player reports the Rosetta-based launcher working after updating to macOS 27, and another identifies the launcher as x86.

limitation: The Rosetta reports predate 3.15.20 and there was no runtime test of that precise build.
notes: Homebrew's disabled status applies to its cask. Ankama still publishes a Mac update manifest.

name: TrojanX
product: TrojanX, the macOS proxy client by JimLee1996

evidence.says: GitHub identifies JimLee1996's proxy client for macOS and records that its owner archived the repository on September 20, 2026.
The project's latest published release is tag 0.4 dated November 21, 2020.
The old scan records an Intel executable and a bundle copyright naming JimLee1996, which identifies this project among the same-named apps.

limitation: The historical bundle reports version 1.0 and was Intel-only. The version mapping and architecture of the final 0.4 release asset were not independently verified.
notes: The legacy release remains in the archived project.

name: Bastion
product: Bastion BHAP Mac utility under the Venustech bundle namespace

evidence.says: The scan records an Intel-only Bastion 1.0 bundle with the Venustech identifier and bhap URL handler.
Venustech describes a desktop client for its Tianyue OSM bastion product without naming the scanned Mac bundle, a macOS version, or a CPU architecture.

limitation: No public macOS release, exact vendor client mapping, or current architecture was found.
notes: The bundle may be a companion to Venustech's enterprise bastion product.

name: Express Burn Disc-Brennprogramm
product: Express Burn Disc-Brennprogramm Free (German edition) by NCH Software

evidence.says: NCH's German freeware directory links the Express Burn Free Mac download.
I inspected the official free ZIP's ExpressBurn.app/Contents/MacOS/Express Burn and verified that bundle com.nchsoftware.expressburndefree version 14.04 is x86_64 only.
The German changelog dates Mac version 14.04 to February 28, 2025.

limitation: I found no Rosetta runtime report for this German free build.
notes: NCH's separate 14.04 German paid download has a different bundle ID, com.nchsoftware.expressburndepaid, and I found both arm64 and x86_64 slices in that build.

name: Juicebox
product: Juicebox Desktop by Aiden Lab and Broad Institute

evidence.says: Aiden Lab links the signed Mac DMG for its 2.x desktop line and directs users to GitHub releases for newer JARs.
I inspected Juicebox.app/Contents/MacOS/Juicebox in the official 2.15 DMG and found that it is x86_64 only.
The uploaded metadata gives juicebox.MainWindow as both the older Mac bundle identifier and Java main class.
Aiden Lab's Mac packaging source identifies juicebox.MainWindow as the main class of the Juicebox app.

limitation: I found no Apple Silicon runtime report for the 2.15 Mac DMG and no verified release date.
notes: The signed 2.15 package uses bundle ID DMEMFH4A9M.org.aidenlab.juicebox. The finding covers the packaged Mac app.

name: SetResX
product: Phoenix Dev SetResX, later called Retina DisplayMenu (RDM)

evidence.says: Contemporaneous users identify Retina DisplayMenu as the renamed SetResX app.
The compatibility directory attributes the original RDM to Phoenix Dev and reports its removal from the developer's site.
The successor repository credits a separate original project and was itself archived in December 2023.
Static inspection of this versioned release found both Intel and arm64 slices in RDM.app/Contents/MacOS/RDM, with the distinct bundle ID net.alkalay.RDM.

limitation: The final version and architecture of the exact Phoenix Dev bundle could not be verified.
notes: The Homebrew hint is for the usr-sse2 fork. Its universal 2.5.0 build applies to net.alkalay.RDM.

name: Starline Master
product: StarLine Master for macOS by StarLine

evidence.says: StarLine identifies its desktop configuration utility and still mentions macOS on the general product page.
The official download history provides no Mac builds for current releases, including version 3.11.5 dated November 23, 2026.
A user on StarLine's support forum reports the removal of the Mac download and separately reports finding an older Mac build numbered 3.10.2.
Archived scan metadata identifies the exact StarLine bundle and an earlier Intel-only version 3.6.2.

limitation: Public downloads indicate the Mac edition is no longer distributed, but a separate discontinuation announcement and the architecture and version of the final Mac build were not found.
notes: The product continues on other platforms.

name: EdrawMax
product: Wondershare EdrawMax (万兴图示, formerly 亿图图示), the desktop diagram editor

evidence.says: Wondershare’s reply on the Chinese Mac App Store page provides a separate, versioned 15.1.9 Mac download directly from the vendor.
The versioned 15.1.9 Chinese Mac download linked by the vendor resolves successfully.
The submitted Mac app inventory records the exact com.edrawsoft.edrawmax bundle in a universal 15.1.9 version.
Homebrew packages an older 14.5.2 build and flags that build as Intel and Rosetta-dependent.

limitation: The universal finding is tied to 15.1.9 for the exact bundle via an inventory report. The direct archive exceeds the inspection limit, and the current English download’s architecture is unverified.
notes: The vendor distributes different Mac builds by channel. The Mac App Store package uses com.edrawsoft.edrawmax.mac. The direct 15.1.9 download and exact-bundle report are the basis for this record.

name: ExactScan Pro
product: ExactScan Pro by ExactCODE GmbH

evidence.says: ExactCODE lists its current Pro series as version 26 for macOS and provides the Pro trial through an email form, without stating the CPU architecture.
ExactCODE distinguishes the Pro edition from standard ExactScan and the older Mac App Store build.
The historical upload verifies the Pro bundle ID and describes the x86 executable in v22.6.

limitation: The current Pro binary's architecture and exact 26.x build are unverified. The vendor's publicly linked standard ExactScan download is a separate edition.
notes: The historical Intel Pro scan cannot establish the architecture of the current Pro version.

name: Rumpus
product: Rumpus for macOS, Maxum Development’s file transfer server

evidence.says: Maxum identifies 11.1.3 as the current Mac download and lists macOS 12 or later, including Tahoe.
Static inspection of the vendor’s 11.1.3 DMG confirmed com.maxum.Rumpus and an x86_64-only Mach-O header at Rumpus.app/Contents/MacOS/Rumpus.

limitation: A vendor statement or credible firsthand report confirming Rosetta operation was not found. The server daemon was not inspected.
notes: 11.1.3 is the release label on Maxum’s download page and disk image. The inspected app’s Info.plist reports short version 11.0 and build 1.
